items.summary: Tesla now has to prove to government regulators that its Cybercab — which has no steering wheel or pedals — is legal to sell, and safe for the road.

items.title: How worried should software, semiconductor stocks be about AI risks?
items.summary: SK hynix (SKHY) is reportedly in talks with Intel (INTC) to use the latter's facilities to manufacture memory chips in the US for the first time, according to Reuters. Yahoo Finance's Jake Conley and Pras Subramanian are joined by RBC Capital Markets head of derivatives strategy Amy Wu Silverman to examine how the software industry is reacting to AI headlines, comparing it to the internet booms of the past.

items.title: Should You Buy Amazon Stock For The Demand AWS Cannot Yet Serve?
items.summary: Amazon.com (AMZN) stock has returned 8.9% over the past twelve months and trades about 13% below its 52-week high. Its cloud arm spent those months doing something the share price has not reflected. AWS growth sped up again in Q2 2026, and the contracts queued up behind it kept building. The upside case for the stock rests almost entirely on turning that queue into revenue.

items.summary: Synchrony Financial’s 18.8% return over the past six months has outpaced the S&P 500 by 5.1%, and its stock price has climbed to $76.06 per share. This was partly thanks to its solid quarterly results, and the performance may have investors wondering how to approach the situation.
